angles.title: A mood more than an idea

uses.quote: I had a feeling about something, like a mood more than an idea
it felt like it mattered while I was walking, and I can't say why
I just wanted to get the feeling down before it goes

open_questions: Is the piece about the feeling itself, or about trying (and failing) to say why it mattered?
What did the feeling actually consist of? The memo names it but never describes it.
Who is this for: yourself, readers of personal essays, other writers who start from a mood?

angles.title: Days I walk

uses.quote: Maybe it's about how I feel different on days I walk.
something about routines, but I don't know what I would say about routines that people haven't already said a hundred times
It was about mornings, I think, or maybe about the walk.

open_questions: How do you feel different on days you walk? The memo says you do, not how.
What would you say about routines that hasn't been said a hundred times? You raise this yourself.
Is it mornings, the walk, or routine in general? You name all three and settle on none.

angles.title: Which part of the city

uses.quote: My sister says I should write about the city more, but I don't know which part of the city.
The light was nice. There were a lot of dogs out.
I could write about the dogs, but that seems silly.

open_questions: The memo doesn't say the walk was in the city. Was it, and is that the part you'd write about?
Which part of the city? You say you don't know yet.
Is the city your own idea, or only your sister's suggestion?
